# Iron Vow Rig Bench credits

| Item | Source | Rights |
|---|---|---|
| Warden geometry, paint, stencil lettering, normal and ORM maps | Original Mark II armor and materials created for Iron Vow.  | Original project assets. No upstream asset license. |
| Kestrel, Hailstorm, Longbow, Breaker, Cleaver and Piledriver | Original work created for this brief.  | Original project assets. No upstream asset license. |
| Rig Bench, hangar, procedural fallback, effects, audio and controls | User-supplied `iron-vow-rig.html`, with this package's GLB integration. | Existing project material. |
| three.js r128 and GLTFLoader | [three.js r128](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128), exact r128 scripts served from this bench’s vendor directory. | [MIT](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r128/LICENSE) |

The production meshes and textures contain no external geometry, textures, fonts, or kitbash assets. The Mark II uses Iron Vow’s existing Warden concept art as an internal visual reference. The geometry, textures and markings were authored for this game.

## Workshop expansion

The Kestrel and Basilisk chassis, their texture atlases, and the Breacher, Vesper and Rampart models are original Iron Vow assets. The Workshop renders derive from these and the existing Warden and weapon meshes. The color masks derive from the original model UVs. The expansion uses no external model or texture assets.

## Battlefield and armory visual pass

All updated meshes, ground textures, and cover sprites are original Iron Vow work. BattleTech's published terrain categories, partial-cover presentation, and use of clear unit roles informed the design direction. No BattleTech art, models, maps, or names were imported.
